tasks.title: Formal monthly board meeting
tasks.description: Three-hour quorum: consent agenda, CEO report, exec session tail. You run the room.

tasks.title: Live audit committee session
tasks.description: Walk the control matrix with the audit chair — no async deck substitutes.

tasks.title: Comp committee live review
tasks.description: Approve option refreshes and exec pay bands in a recorded session.

tasks.title: Strategy deep-dive (full board)
tasks.description: Whiteboard TAM, pricing power, and the one bet you are doubling down on.

tasks.title: Crisis war room with board
tasks.description: Outage, PR flare, or churn spike — directors on Zoom until there is a plan.

tasks.title: Fundraise pricing committee
tasks.description: Term sheet math live — lead wants your ask, dilution, and use of proceeds on one slide.

tasks.title: CEO performance review
tasks.description: Lead director runs the session; you present goals, misses, and the recovery plan.

tasks.title: Independent executive session
tasks.description: Directors meet without management — you wait in the hall with coffee.

tasks.title: Customer proof session
tasks.description: Two reference CEOs join for thirty minutes; board asks the hard renewal questions.

tasks.title: IPO readiness board readout
tasks.description: S-1 timeline, dual-class debate, and banker roster — everyone leaves with owners.

tasks.title: Board earnings call prep
tasks.description: Script the quarter narrative with directors before the public call.

tasks.title: Buyback authorization vote
tasks.description: Model repurchase bands; board votes yes/no on the authorization size.

tasks.title: M&A live diligence review
tasks.description: Target deck, synergy ranges, and integration risks — partners want numbers, not vibes.

tasks.title: Succession tabletop
tasks.description: If you get hit by a bus — who runs product, who talks to investors?

tasks.title: ESG & investor day dry run
tasks.description: Full board attends the dress rehearsal for your investor day keynote.
